Photosynthesis
Green plants make their own food in the leaves. Chlorophyll traps light energy from the sun.
The plant takes in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil.
Glucose is made, and oxygen is given out.
The equation is: carbon dioxide + water -> glucose + oxygen, using light energy and chlorophyll.
In an experiment, a leaf kept in the dark for 48 hours gave a negative starch test.
model_answer_with_placeholders:
Igbo:
Ndị osisi na-eme nri ha onwe ha n’ime akwụkwọ ha. Chlorophyll na-ejide ike ọkụ site na anyanwụ.
Osisi ahụ na-anakọta carbon dioxide n’ikuku ma mmiri si n’ala.
A na-emepụta glucose, a na-ahapụkwa oxygen.
Ntuziaka bụ: carbon dioxide + mmiri -> glucose + oxygen, jiri ike ọkụ na chlorophyll.
Na nnwale, akwukwo osisi e debere n’ọchịchịrị maka ⟦N1⟧ nyere ule starch adịghị mma.
Ọ bụrụ na a ga-achọ ozi ndị ọzọ ma ọ bụ nkọwa gbasara akwukwo osisi, biko jụọ onye nkuzi ma ọ bụ onye isi.
